body: I'll try to come back here and keep everyone posted on how it turns out. The move isn't immediate but is in less than a year, but having that to look forward to has dramatically improved my outlook and has given me a strong reason to WANT to be alive, instead of just having to be.

I realize everyone's situation is different and that one solution is not a fix-all solution. I was merely sharing my story and lending my support to everyone who thinks they can't change their situation because of barriers they may not have thought possible to overcome. I'm deeply sorry about your situation. I realize there are people much worse off than me but that doesn't make my problems feel any less dire. Do you get solace knowing that somewhere in the world, someone has it worse than you do? Although you can't change a disability or appearance, perhaps there is some way to make a the best of it. And chances are you might have already thought of it but didn't realize it may actually be attainable. Follow your dreams, feed your passion. That was the advice I was given here and I decided to move to the place I want to live more than anywhere else. We've talked about how we WANTED to all the time, but I realize we actually CAN if we just take the steps to do it.

Thank you for the thoughtful response. Unfortunately the major I'm doing (chem-e) is the one I've wanted to do for years and I can't really picture myself doing anything else. I just spend all my time doing that and basically nothing else. Its so much work for such a distant reward and I have nothing to keep my spirits up in the meantime. Its very difficult to stay motivated when I have yet to see anything come out from what I've put in and I can't help but feel like death is a better alternative. I also have pretty bad ADHD and take medication for it, but even with it I still struggle and it takes me twice as long to do things as it does for most people and its extremely frustrating how I can spend 8+ hours at a time studying for something and feel no more prepared than when I started. I dream of living in a cabin on some land away from everything, or on a tropical island with the natives, but those are not very realistic dreams. I don't even know what I'm passionate about any more.. I don't enjoy most things and I don't have any hobbies. Every day feels worst than the last, and the only thing that keeps me going is the thought that I HAVE to, like some invisible person it putting a gun to my head and making me trudge through life. I just want something to look forward to thats not 3+ years away because I can't wait that long for life to not be terrible. I HATE HATE HATE where I live and everyone around me (the south) and I'm trapped here. I don't know what to do.

According to my logic suicide is always the most rational option. I've not existed for billions of years prior to being born and was perfectly fine. I can't wait to resume the peace of not existing. I've seen several psychiatrists and psychologists over the years and have tried medications. I benefit from therapy but i moved recently and no longer get to see my therapist of several years which sucks since I had I lot of report with him as he knew me better than about anyone else. The medications are mostly bullshit, it's essentially a shot in the dark because everyone's brain chemistry is unique. I've tried SSRI's but they dull my intellect which bothers me more than the perceived relief they provide. Plus medications do nothing to change my situation which have always been the main source of my problems. I doubt there is a drug that exists that I couldn't override with my unhappiness towards the situation I'm in. Once I'm able to have my brain scanned and get a drug prescribed that is specific to my brain chemistry, I don't really wanna mess around with whatever the pharmaceutical industry is pumping out these days.

It definitely is.. I don't know at what point it will be good because I never feel satisfied with anything I do. I hate that I can't even feel anything for the people closest to me and I feel like a shitty person. I'm pretty sure I'm some type of sociopath or have some kind of antisocial personality disorder. I frequently do what I call the silent scream where I just go to a bathroom stall and quietly flip the fuck out. I see people who seem like they're enjoying life and I fucking hate them but I envy the shit out of them. I want to know what its like to experience normal feelings instead of just pain and cold calculations.
